policies.title: Refund Policy
policies.text: Customers may request a full refund within 14 days of the purchase date for physical items that are unused and in original packaging. A refund request must include the order number and the purchase date. Requests made after 14 days are not eligible for a refund; the agent may offer store credit of 50% of the item price instead. Digital products are not refundable once downloaded.

policies.title: Delivery Delay Policy
policies.text: Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days after the shipping date. If an order has not arrived 7 business days after shipping, support opens a carrier investigation and sets the ticket to In Progress. If the order has not arrived 10 business days after shipping, the customer may choose a free re-shipment or a full refund. The order number and shipping date are required to apply this policy.

policies.title: Account Access Policy
policies.text: After 5 failed login attempts an account is locked for 30 minutes. Customers can unlock it sooner by requesting a password reset link sent only to the registered email address. Support staff must never ask for or accept a customer's password. If the customer cannot access the registered email, the ticket must be escalated to the Security team for identity verification.
